subcommittees.name: Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects owners and operators of U.S. maritime transportation facilities subject to security plan requirements and foreign entities from targeted countries.
dimensions.evidence: An owner or operator of a facility for which a facility security plan is required... may not enter into a contract... with an entity that is a Chinese, Russian, North Korean, or Iranian state-owned enterprise

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a direct legal restriction on commercial contracting for critical port and maritime infrastructure facilities.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits certain contracts for port operations and management

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are stated in the source text.
Amends title 46, United States Code, to add a new statutory prohibition on specific port contracts.
dimensions.evidence: amend title 46, United States Code, to prohibit certain contracts for port operations and management

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory prohibition affecting maritime facility contracts nationwide.

Economic impact estimates on trade or port operations
importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits owners or operators of specified U.S. maritime transportation facilities from contracting for lease, ownership, or operation with entities owned by China, Russia, North Korea, or Iran.
